lines.zh: 盔甲响成一片，我照走不误。
lines.en: My armor clatters; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我迈着重步，钉子踩进土里。
lines.en: Heavy steps drive my boot nails into dirt.

lines.zh: 斧子搭在肩上，我横着走。
lines.en: Axe on my shoulder, I walk abreast.
The road is rough; my steps grow heavier.
I walk at the front of the column.

lines.zh: 铁片相撞，远远就听得见。
lines.en: Iron plates clash and carry a long way.
I do not go around; I go through.
I watch both flanks as I advance.
A little sweat has pooled in my helmet.
My boot soles are worn through; I walk on.
I cross the mud and leave deep ruts.
Keep up; do not let the line break.

lines.zh: 我把斧刃在袖子上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I wipe the axe blade on my sleeve.
I lean on the wall, armor still on.
I count the windows across the street.
The pauldron makes my neck ache.
I crack each knuckle while I wait.
Wind slips through my helmet and cools me.

lines.zh: 我盯着路口，什么也没想。
lines.en: I stare at the crossing and think nothing.

lines.zh: 这身甲，穿着比脱了安心。
lines.en: Wearing this armor feels safer than removing it.
I shift the weapon to my other hand.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我听着铁响。
lines.en: In the quiet I listen to my own iron.
Give me distance; one step will do.
I look at you through the helmet slit.
You do not look like a fighter.
My grip tightens on the handle.
You are unmarked; no wounds on you.

lines.zh: 我认得那件外套的颜色。
lines.en: I know that color of coat.
Go on; I am listening.
Keep your hands out of your pockets.

lines.zh: 我看你，是在量你的力气。
lines.en: I am sizing up your strength.
Stand there; I will come to you.

lines.zh: 甲凹了一块，骨头应该没事。
lines.en: A plate is dented; the bone should be fine.
The blow forced me back half a step.
That one was heavy; I admit it.
I spit blood and keep coming.
I braced on the wall to stay upright.
The helmet is too close to breathe in.
I cannot lift this shoulder anymore.
It hurts; do not stop swinging.

lines.zh: 我跪了一下，很快又起来。
lines.en: I went to one knee, then rose quickly.

lines.zh: 这伤得养几天，今天不行。
lines.en: This needs days to heal, not today.
We eat after the fighting is done.

lines.zh: 你手里那块饼，我不稀罕。
lines.en: That flatbread you hold means little to me.

lines.zh: 我缺的不是吃的，是好刀。
lines.en: What I lack is a good blade, not food.
Do not wave things in front of my face.
I take emeralds; you keep the bread.
I smell drink; put it away.
I am hungry, but work comes first.
That little would not even fill a gap.
If you give, give the whole thing.
I wave you off; do not waste time.
Running into me is running into a wall.
I did not shift my feet; you backed off.
Armor hits armor with a harsh sound.
Clear the way; this armor does not squeeze by.
You struck my pauldron.
I bar my arm and push you aside.

lines.zh: 别挤，队伍里没这个位置。
lines.en: Do not crowd; there is no room in line.
I stumble once and my plates rattle.

lines.zh: 再撞，我就不只是推开了。
lines.en: Bump me again and I stop merely pushing.

lines.zh: 我站稳了，脚下压出印子。
lines.en: I plant myself and the ground takes a print.
I have no time for that.
Pillagers do not bother with such things.
Put your strength to better use.

lines.zh: 我戴着盔，看不清你的脸。
lines.en: With this helmet on, I cannot see your face.
Move along; I have a blade to sharpen.

lines.zh: 这种时候，谈这个不合规矩。
lines.en: This is not the time or the custom.
The only thing I lead is a charge.
Do not lean against my armor.
There is no space in these ranks.
Another time; for now, stand ready.
This can be traded for emeralds.
I bend and my armor sticks.
What lies on the ground, I take.

lines.zh: 我早就想要一把这样的刀。
lines.en: I have wanted a blade like this.
Let go; this pile is mine.
This sack is heavy; I can carry it.
I tuck it behind my belt.
Emeralds go into the lining.
I weigh it; not worth much.

lines.zh: 有用的留下，剩下的烧了。
lines.en: Keep what is useful, burn the rest.
The one at the crossing; I take it.

lines.zh: 我看见它握刀的手在抖。
lines.en: I see the hand holding its blade tremble.
Nobody move; this one is mine.
Someone has come out of the house.
It blocks the door, so I break through.
I raise my hand and the others halt.
Its armor is thin; that is easy.

lines.zh: 我听见了铁碰铁的声音。
lines.en: I heard iron strike iron.
It steps back, which means it is afraid.
I am not going back empty-handed.
There are two shadows ahead.
I move forward and close the road.
It raised a hand; is it begging?
Begging will not help; those are the rules.

lines.zh: 那扇门开了条缝，里面有人。
lines.en: That door opened a crack, and someone is inside.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把斧举起来。
lines.en: I crouch and lift the axe.
Let it swing first; I catch and return.
Left foot forward; that is steady.
It keeps watching my hands; stop that.
I am keeping count of its paces.
My breathing sounds loud inside the helmet.

lines.zh: 它退到墙边，没地方躲了。
lines.en: It backs to the wall with nowhere left.

lines.zh: 我抬起盾，挡住它的视线。
lines.en: I raise my shield and cut off its view.
Within two paces the axe reaches it.
It wants to run; I slide sideways.
My grip on the haft tightens.
The landing point is its left shoulder.
The smell of iron is getting closer.
I wait for it to finish this breath.

lines.zh: 我把门口的箱子踢开，让路。
lines.en: I kick the crate from the doorway to clear a path.

lines.zh: 你躲进屋里，我就守窗子。
lines.en: You hide inside, so I watch the window.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步声，隔道墙。
lines.en: I count your steps through the wall.

lines.zh: 你换手拿武器，我看见了。
lines.en: You switch hands on your weapon. I saw.
The axe falls and its shield splits.
I shove it back and strike again.

lines.zh: 刃口卡在甲缝里，我拔出来。
lines.en: The blade sticks in a seam; I pull it free.
It swung wide; perfect.

lines.zh: 我顶膝，再压上整个身子。
lines.en: I drive a knee, then lean my whole weight.

lines.zh: 这一下打在它腿上，它跪了。
lines.en: That hit its leg and it dropped to a knee.
Iron on iron and my hand goes numb.
It tries to grab me; I throw it off.
I turn the shield edge into it.

lines.zh: 它倒了，我踩住它的武器。
lines.en: It fell; I pin its weapon underfoot.
Do not shout; it is too late anyway.
There is sweat all over my axe haft.
One blow is not enough; here is another.

lines.zh: 它不动了，我把刃擦干净。
lines.en: It stopped moving; I wipe the blade clean.

lines.zh: 斧背砸下去，压得你蹲身。
lines.en: The flat of my axe drives you to a crouch.

lines.zh: 我用肩撞开你，再横劈一记。
lines.en: I shoulder you aside, then swing across.

lines.zh: 我踏进村子，铁片一路响。
lines.en: I enter the village and my plates ring.
The heavy one has arrived; clear out.
The band needed someone to stand in front.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，先看看里面。
lines.en: I stand at the gate and look inside first.
This armor has walked three days of road.
Someone told me there is coin here.

lines.zh: 我把武器从肩上放下来。
lines.en: I lower the weapon from my shoulder.
The wind carries smoke and blood.
Step aside; I am not in the habit of detours.
Let us see who moves first.
This village is quiet in the wrong way.
Stay close behind me; do not fall out.
The fire heats my armor until it burns.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，甲先着地。
lines.en: I fell down the steps and landed on armor.

lines.zh: 水灌进盔里，我什么都听不见。
lines.en: Water fills my helmet and I hear nothing.

lines.zh: 我被掀翻了，耳朵里全是风。
lines.en: The blast flipped me; my ears are all wind.
An arrow is wedged in my shoulder joint.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的手指发木。
lines.en: That force left my fingers numb.
Three days unfed and I cannot swing.

lines.zh: 雷劈在刀上，我整只手都麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit my blade and numbed my arm.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，甲太重，抓不住。
lines.en: I fell; the armor was too heavy to grip.
